plan.title: Change RFP Question Field Type in Table View

steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen for the technical RFP setup.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Apply an available RFP template before working with its questions.
Ensure the RFP questionnaire contains at least one question.

args.goal: In the RFP questionnaire Table View, open the Edit control next to a Vendor Response field type, verify that the available types are exactly Short Text, Long Text, Single Select, Radio, Number, Attachment, and Date, choose a different type, and stop with the question showing the newly selected field type.

steps.note: Perform and verify the field-type edit interaction that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Confirm the final questionnaire view has no visible application errors or rendering issues.
